newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Norwich chief Jonson leaves for ANZ Funds.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Norwich chief Jonson leaves for ANZ Funds.

text.p: Australian fund manager Norwich Union Financial Services Group said on Thursday that managing director Peter Jonson had resigned and retail business director Barrie Laws had been appointed interim chief executive.
In a separate announcement, Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said Jonson had been appointed as the new managing director of ANZ Funds Management.
ANZ said Jonson would join its executive group on March 3.

"We are delighted to welcome Peter to ANZ. He has significant experience in funds management, financial services and merchant banking and I am confident he will successfully guide ANZ Funds Management as it takes on the exciting challenges ahead in the financial services industry," ANZ chief executive Don Mercer said in a statement.

Jonson had been with Norwich since 1990 and held senior executive positions with James Capel Australia Ltd and Wardley James Capel Corporate Finance Ltd and handled macro-economic and international policy matters at the Reserve Bank of Australia.
Norwich said a search for a permanent appointment would be undertaken by the group.
Norwich is wholly-owned by the Norwich Union Group of Britain.
